text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Sentry ingestion rate for org 'redwood-prod' dropped ~98% starting now. Missing exception events detected. https://status.sentry.io/incident/abc123
alex: grabbing this. oncall rn. can someone confirm whether this is affecting only Sentry or other observability sinks too?
emily: seeing same in our internal metrics. sentry.ingest.count sank at 1793456700. logs show lots of 502/504 to sentry-ingest-prod
chris: fwiw datadog traces and logs look normal. just the error events missing. stackdriver/metrics still fine.
alex: trying a quick synthetic capture to the DSN from prod gateway
alex: ```bash
curl -v -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"message":"sentry test"}' $SENTRY_DSN/api/0/envelope/
```
alex: curl returns 502 Bad Gateway and HTML from vendor proxy
emily: can you curl the alternative DSN (secondary/ingest-backup)?
alex: tried backup DSN, it accepts 202. so backup path works.
ops-oncall: proposed mitigation: switch error-forwarder service to use backup DSN, toggle in config map. rolling restart shouldn't be disruptive.
chris: agree. prepping k8s command.
alex: patch ready. config map name error-forwarder-config, key SENTRY_DSN. new value: https://ingest-secondary.sentry.example/\n
alex: applying now
alex: ```bash
kubectl set env deployment/error-forwarder SENTRY_DSN=https://ingest-secondary.sentry.example -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/error-forwarder -n prod
```
emily: restart kicked off, pods coming up
support: heads-up: queueing a short note on status page and telling a couple of customers asking about missing errors. say "observability: error reporting delayed" until we confirm.
support: suggested status page line: "We are aware of delayed error ingestion to our external error-reporting vendor. We're routing errors to a fallback path and assessing completeness."
ops-oncall: monitoring acceptance; please do not merge unrelated changes to error-forwarder while this is hot.
alex: seeing 202s now from error-forwarder to backup DSN, events are appearing in backup Sentry org
emily: verifying backlog: we have ~12k events dropped at vendor entrypoint between 1793456700-1793457600. backup path accepted ~2k so far; the rest might be permanently lost at vendor side.
chris: important: our SDK retries were limited. we need to surface this to product/support: magnitude estimate ~12k events, but only ~1k unique users impacted in that window.
support: opened a support ticket template for affected customers. linking post below. can we create a status update to customers by EOD with estimated impact and remediation steps?
alex: incident-bot: creating incident page and paging rotation
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0412-1. Severity: S3. Paging ops-oncall, chris
ops-oncall: I have it. handing off from alex in 15m -> will continue mitigation and shepherd postmortem.
opsoncall: (typo) meant ops-oncall
alex: handoff summary: root cause is upstream vendor proxy failures returning 502s leading to dropped envelopes. quick mitigation: changed SENTRY_DSN to secondary ingest, restarted error-forwarder. partial recovery: events now ingested via backup but some events during the gap are likely lost. alerting/monitoring remains on.
ops-oncall: reassigning roles: emily -> telemetry verification, chris -> impact estimate + SDK retry config followup, support -> customer comms, alex -> postmortem owner
emily: running eval scripts to confirm full fidelity. script output snippet:
```
# check missing exceptions by project
python tools/check_sentry_backfill.py --since 2026-04-12T09:05:00Z --until 2026-04-12T09:45:00Z
# output: projects 12 show counter delta != expected; approx 9.8k events not present in vendor org
```
chris: initial impact notes: no user-facing crashes reported, majority are non-fatal exceptions in background jobs and scheduled tasks. customer-facing features appear functional. severity S3 is reasonable.
support: drafting customer message now, will share for review. suggestion: "No user-facing downtime; some diagnostic error events may be missing from the vendor UI for a short window. We've applied a fallback and are investigating lost events." add contact for escalations.
ops-oncall: does our policy require backfill from local logs? can we attempt to re-ingest lost envelopes from persistence layer (local buffer or kafka)?
emily: we persisted raw envelopes to kafka for 48h. can replay to backup DSN. I'll start a replay job to backfill the missing window.
emily: replay in progress; will throttle at 200rps to avoid overloading backup endpoint
alex: careful: we need idempotency keys; Sentry deduplicates by event id but our envelopes may include same IDs. emily please run dedupe step.
emily: yes, will dedupe before replay. ETA ~45m to finish initial backfill.
ops-oncall: support update: status page updated and incident linked. assigned SLA owner to monitor customer replies.
postmortem-bot: Reminder: create a postmortem doc within 72 hours and assign severity tags.
alex: posting brief timeline in thread later; moving to post-handoff mode. tagging postmortem owner @alex
ops-oncall: taking over. summary for next oncall: root cause upstream ingress failure at vendor proxy, mitigation: swapped DSN and replayed persisted envelopes, partial data loss likely for period 1793456700-1793457600. next steps: postmortem, adjust SDK retry/backoff, consider multi-ingest primary/secondary in config, ask vendor for RCA and credits.
chris: adding action item: increase SDK retries from 3->6 for 502/5xx, and add exponential backoff jitter. I'll open PR and tag infra for review.
support: will send customer-facing note after internal review. will escalate to account teams for customers with heavy telemetry needs.
ops-oncall: marking incident as mitigated once replay completes and monitoring stable. leaving this thread open until postmortem doc created. :white_check_mark:
